need: Turn every built-in Module Studio Execute conversation into a proactive operations feed: channel events create durable workspace-scoped tasks, AI posts trusted MarkdownComponent and typed widgets linked to the kind workbench, and each module kind owns a distinct reply policy.
negativeBoundary: Do not expand custom modules, Flashcards, the legacy Telegram route, StarCi skill infrastructure, arbitrary HTML or script rendering, ReactNode escape slots, pod-only queues, or historical message rewrites.
acceptanceCriteria: Support Desk proactively reports customer, file, SLA, escalation, and opt-out events with support-task widgets and policy-safe replies.
Finance reports approvals, exceptions, reconciliations, and audit evidence with accounting-specific replies and trusted approval widgets.
Scheduling reports appointments, conflicts, reminders, and rescheduling choices with calendar-specific replies and trusted calendar widgets.
Knowledge Hub reports ingested files, citations, conflicting evidence, and research tasks with source-grounded replies and trusted document widgets.
Every channel event, message, task, widget action, and AI decision is durable, workspace-scoped, bound to the exact immutable context version used, and survives controller restarts.

Execute renders a trusted versioned MessageTree whose MarkdownComponent is sanitized and whose typed widget components and actions are allowlisted; arbitrary HTML, script, raw JSX trees, and ReactNode escape slots are rejected.
A message widget opens and focuses the same durable task in the right-side kind workbench, and a permitted workbench or widget action updates the shared task and conversation state.

Real-browser UAT proves proactive ingress, task creation, kind-specific reply, widget rendering, workbench linkage, responsive layout, and immutable context binding for all four built-in module kinds.

accepts: Proactive operations conversations driven by Telegram and other configured channel events.
Durable workspace-scoped task queues linked bidirectionally to trusted message widgets and kind workbenches.
Sanitized MarkdownComponent plus versioned typed widget components and kind-specific AI reply policies.
rejects: Founder-only manual Execute chat or one generic reply policy shared by every module kind.
Arbitrary HTML, script, ReactNode escape slots, handwritten raw JSX trees, ephemeral pod-only queues, or history rewrites.
Custom-module expansion, Flashcard work, legacy Telegram route changes, or StarCi skill-infrastructure changes.
